a.lede: Millions kept changing hands long after the election outcomes were effectively settled.
a.title: Polymarket saw $600 million in election trades after the elections were over

b.lede: Contracts tied to elections in Ethiopia and Romania saw massive trading volumes after the outcomes were decided. “It’s obviously some form of volume manipulation,” one expert says.
b.title: Over $600 Million in Polymarket Election Trades Took Place After Races Ended
